name: dugout
description: Search DugOut's pool of independent filmmakers, animators and storytellers in plain English, with fit scores, reasons grounded in their uploads, and DugOut profile cards.

interface.shortDescription: Find independent filmmakers, animators and storytellers
interface.longDescription: Search DugOut's pool of independent creators on YouTube and Vimeo in plain English: a role, a Genre, a tone, a comparable or a budget. Each result shows a fit score, whether they're a genuine fit or a stretch, a reason grounded in their uploads, their IP, Audience, Story and Momentum scores, and a link to their DugOut profile. Requires a DugOut account.
